name: Indorenate
summary: Indorenate (developmental code name TR-3369), also known as β-methoxycarbonyl-5-methoxytryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B and 5-HT2C serotonin receptors.

pharmacology.text: Indorenate (developmental code name TR-3369), also known as β-methoxycarbonyl-5-methoxytryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B and 5-HT2C serotonin receptors.

summaryZh: 吲哚瑞酯（英語：Indorenate，研發代號：TR-3369）是一種色胺衍生物，常作為5-HT1A、5-HT1B、5-HT2C等血清素受體的激動劑。它具有抗焦慮、降壓和降食慾的作用，主要是通過激動5-HT1A受體來完成，但5-HT1B和5-HT2C也有可能起一定作用，另外一些非血清素受體也可能是它的靶標。
